title: Sticky budget table header
description: Add sticky positioning to the budget table header so column names remain visible when scrolling through many budget rows. Add 'sticky top-0 z-10 bg-background' classes to the TableHeader in budget-table.tsx.

title: Fix budget progress bar color at 100%
description: The progress bar shows red at exactly 100% usage, but 100% means fully used (not overspent). Change getProgressBarColor to use the budget's 'available' amount instead of percentage to determine red: only show red when available < 0 (overspent). Pass 'available' prop to BudgetProgressBar component.

title: Fix month change redirecting to budgets from transactions page
description: The MonthProvider's setMonth always navigates to /budgets/{month}, so changing the month on the transactions page redirects to budgets. Fix by using usePathname() to conditionally navigate: only push to /budgets/{month} when on the budgets page, otherwise update month via local state override without changing the route.

title: Show all non-archived budgets in transaction filter dropdown
description: The budget filter dropdown in transactions uses GetBudgetsDocument with activeOnly: true, which calls findActive(new Date()) on the backend. This excludes expired (past endDate) budgets that may still have transactions. Change to activeOnly: false so all non-archived budgets appear in the filter dropdown. Also check transaction-detail-panel.tsx for the same issue.

title: Add URL search params support to Transactions page
description: Extract getDateRangeFromMonth() to shared web/src/lib/url-utils.ts with buildTransactionsUrl() helper. Update TransactionsTable to accept optional initialFilters prop. Update transactions page.tsx to read URL search params (budgetId, dateFrom, dateTo, etc.) via useSearchParams() and pass as initialFilters. Update unbudgeted-transactions-warning.tsx to import from shared utility.

title: Add clickable navigation from budget rows to filtered transactions
description: In budget-table.tsx, make budget name a next/link pointing to /transactions?budgetId=<id>&dateFrom=<first>&dateTo=<last> using the month from useMonth() and buildTransactionsUrl() helper. Also add 'View Transactions' item to the budget row dropdown menu (three dots). Ensure link does not interfere with drag-and-drop (drag handle is separate).

title: Sync transaction filters to URL search params (optional enhancement)
description: When user changes filters on the transactions page, update URL search params using router.replace() so filtered views are shareable and bookmarkable. Ensures URL stays in sync with filter state after initial load from search params.

title: Extract TransactionFiltersSidebar component
description: Extract filter controls from TransactionFiltersBar (inside transactions-table.tsx) into a new TransactionFiltersSidebar component in web/src/components/transactions/transaction-filters-sidebar.tsx. Renders all filters vertically (search, account, category, budget, type, status, date range) with a header showing active count and clear-all button. Same props interface as current TransactionFiltersBar.

title: Restructure TransactionsTable to two-column layout with sidebar
description: Modify TransactionsTable to render a two-column flex layout on lg+ screens: left column contains the table and pagination, right column (280px, sticky) contains the TransactionFiltersSidebar. Remove the old TransactionFiltersBar and Popover-based filter UI. On mobile (below lg), show a filter button that opens filters in a Sheet overlay.

title: Update E2E page object and tests for sidebar filters
description: Update TransactionsPage.ts page object: remove openFilters() popover step from filter methods since filters are always visible on desktop. Update filterByAccount/Category/Budget/Type/Status to directly interact with select elements. Update verify-transaction.spec.ts and any other E2E tests that use the filter methods. Add data-qa attributes to the new sidebar container.

title: Update frontend architecture documentation
description: Update docs/frontend-architecture.md to document the new sidebar filter pattern on the transactions page. Add the TransactionFiltersSidebar to the component organization section. Note the responsive behavior (always-visible sidebar on desktop, Sheet on mobile).

title: Add debounced search input for transactions
description: Implement a useDebouncedValue hook and apply a 300ms debounce to the search input in TransactionFiltersBar. This prevents a GraphQL refetch on every keystroke. The search input remains outside the filter popover and continues to trigger filtering independently of the Apply button flow.

title: Split filter state into draft and applied
description: In TransactionsTable, replace the single `filters` state with `draftFilters` and `appliedFilters`. Wire useQuery to appliedFilters only (so draft changes do not trigger refetch). Wire TransactionFiltersBar to read/write draftFilters. Sync draftFilters from appliedFilters when the filter popover opens. Update the Clear button to reset both states.

title: Add Apply and Reset buttons to filter popover
description: Add a sticky footer to the filter PopoverContent with Apply and Reset buttons. Apply copies draftFilters to appliedFilters, resets page to 0, and closes the popover. Reset clears draftFilters to emptyFilters without closing. Apply button is primary when there are unapplied changes, disabled/secondary otherwise. Add data-qa attributes: btn-apply-filters, btn-reset-filters.

title: Prevent filter popover from closing on Select interaction
description: Add onInteractOutside handler to the filter PopoverContent that prevents the popover from closing when the user interacts with a Radix Select portal (dropdown overlay). The popover should only close when Apply is clicked, the Filters button is toggled, or the user clicks outside both the popover and any open Select dropdowns.

title: Update E2E page object and tests for Apply button
description: Update TransactionsPage.ts page object: add applyFilters() method that clicks the Apply button. Update filterByAccount(), filterByCategory(), filterByBudget(), filterByType(), filterByStatus() to set the filter value and then call applyFilters() instead of pressing Escape. Update verify-transaction.spec.ts to work with the new flow. Add data-qa selectors for new buttons.

title: Increase transaction page size from 25 to 50
description: Change PAGE_SIZE constant from 25 to 50 in web/src/components/transactions/transactions-table.tsx to show more transactions per page. The backend already defaults to 50 and supports up to 200, so no server changes needed.

title: Add page number to URL search params for pagination state preservation
description: In TransactionsTable, use useSearchParams/useRouter/usePathname from next/navigation to read initial page from ?page= URL param and sync page changes back to URL via router.replace(). Page 1 omits the param for clean URLs. Wrap TransactionsTable in Suspense in page.tsx. Update handleFilterChange and handleClearFilters to also clear the URL param when resetting to page 0.

title: Update E2E page object and tests for pagination URL changes
description: Add gotoPage(n) helper to TransactionsPage E2E page object that navigates to /transactions?page=N. Update verify-transaction.spec.ts if page size change affects test behavior. Consider adding an E2E test that verifies pagination state is preserved on page refresh.

title: Add Terraform resources for categorization Pub/Sub queue
description: Create Terraform resources: topic (categorization-queue), push subscription (categorization-queue-sub → /webhook/categorize), DLQ topic/sub, IAM bindings. Retry: 10s-600s exponential backoff, 5 max attempts, 120s ack deadline.

title: Create CategorizationQueueGateway domain and infrastructure
description: Add abstract CategorizationQueueGateway in domain/gateways (publish method only). Implement PubSubCategorizationQueueGateway reusing PubSubClient. Register in container.ts with CATEGORIZATION_TOPIC/SUBSCRIPTION env vars.

title: Create EnqueueCategorizationUseCase
description: New use case accepting transactionExternalId, publishes to categorization queue. Minimal DTO: { transactionExternalId: string }. Returns { messageId: string }.

title: Add POST /webhook/categorize endpoint
description: New route in WebhookController. Parses Pub/Sub push envelope via PubSubPushParser. Calls CategorizeTransactionUseCase. Returns 200 on success/already-categorized, 400 on bad data, 500 on rate limit or transient errors to trigger Pub/Sub retry.

title: Update ProcessIncomingTransaction to enqueue categorization
description: Replace inline categorizeTransactionSafely() with enqueue to categorization queue via EnqueueCategorizationUseCase. Remove rate limit retry logic and sleep method. Keep markCategorizationFailed for enqueue failures only.

title: Update CategorizeCommand for queue-based retry
description: Add --via-queue flag to CategorizeCommand that enqueues pending/failed transactions instead of direct LLM calls. Keep direct mode as default for local dev without Pub/Sub.

title: Add CATEGORIZATION_TOPIC env var to webhook service Terraform
description: Add CATEGORIZATION_TOPIC environment variable to webhook Cloud Run service in Terraform, pointing to the categorization-queue topic.

title: Write tests for categorization queue
description: Unit tests for EnqueueCategorizationUseCase, updated ProcessIncomingTransaction (enqueue instead of inline), and /webhook/categorize endpoint handler. Update existing tests that mock categorization.

title: Update infrastructure documentation
description: Update docs/infrastructure.md with new Pub/Sub resources (categorization-queue topic, subscription, DLQ). Document the push-based categorization flow and retry behavior.
